title.en: Volume 363 Biographies 150: Cao Zhenyong, Wen Fu, Ying He, Wang Ding, Mu Zhanga, Pan Shien
title.raw: 卷363 列傳一百五十 曹振镛 文孚 英和 王鼎 穆彰阿 潘世恩

sentences.zh: 列傳一百五十

translations.literal: Biographies 150
translations.idiomatic: Biographies 150

sentences.zh: 曹振鏞文孚英和王鼎穆彰阿潘世恩

translations.literal: Cao Zhenyong, Wen Fu, Ying He, Wang Ding, Mu Zhanga, Pan Shien
translations.idiomatic: Cao Zhenyong, Wen Fu, Ying He, Wang Ding, Mu Zhanga, and Pan Shien

sentences.zh: 曹振鏞，字儷笙，安徽歙縣人，尚書文埴子。

translations.literal: Cao Zhenyong, style name Lisheng, was a native of She County, Anhui, and son of Minister Wen Zhi.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Zhenyong, whose style was Lisheng, came from She County in Anhui and was the son of the minister Wen Zhi.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十六年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: In the forty-sixth year of Qianlong he passed the jinshi examination, was selected as a bachelor of the Hanlin Academy, and was appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: He earned his jinshi degree in the forty-sixth year of the Qianlong reign, entered the Hanlin Academy as a probationer, and received appointment as a compiler.

sentences.zh: 大考三等，高宗以振鏞大臣子，才可用，特擢侍講。

translations.literal: In the grand examination he placed third class; the Gaozong Emperor, considering that Zhenyong was the son of a great minister and that his talent could be used, specially promoted him to expositor.
translations.idiomatic: When he placed in the third class in the palace examination, the Qianlong Emperor judged that Zhenyong, as a senior minister's son with usable talent, deserved a special promotion to expositor.

sentences.zh: 累遷侍讀學士。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to reader-in-waiting of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: He rose step by step to reader-in-waiting of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶三年，大考二等，遷少詹事。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jiaqing, in the grand examination he placed second class and was transferred to junior tutor of the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of the Jiaqing reign he placed second class in the palace examination and was made junior tutor of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 父憂歸，服闋，授通政使。

translations.literal: He returned home on his father's death, and when mourning ended was appointed commissioner of the Office of Transmission.
translations.idiomatic: After returning home to mourn his father and completing the mourning period, he was appointed commissioner of the Office of Transmission.

sentences.zh: 歷內閣學士，工部、吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: He served successively as grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat and as vice minister of the Ministries of Works and Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as a grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat and as vice minister of both the Ministries of Works and Personnel.

sentences.zh: 十一年，擢工部尚書。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was promoted to minister of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was promoted to minister of works.

sentences.zh: 高宗實錄成，加太子少保。

translations.literal: When the Veritable Records of Gaozong were completed, he was given the additional title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: After the Veritable Records of the Qianlong Emperor were completed, he received the additional title of junior guardian of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 調戶部，兼翰林院掌院學士。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue and also served concurrently as chancellor of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: He was moved to the Ministry of Revenue and concurrently served as chancellor of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 十八年，調吏部尚書、協辦大學士。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was transferred to minister of the Ministry of Personnel and appointed assistant grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he became minister of personnel and assistant grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 尋拜體仁閣大學士，管理工部，晉太子太保。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was appointed grand secretary of the Tiren Hall, placed in charge of the Ministry of Works, and advanced to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward he was made grand secretary of the Tiren Hall, put in charge of the Ministry of Works, and promoted to grand guardian of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，仁宗崩，樞臣撰遺詔，稱高宗誕生於避暑山莊，編修劉鳳誥知其誤，告振鏞，振鏞召對陳之，宣宗怒，譴罷樞臣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year the Renzong Emperor died; the Grand Council drafted the testamentary edict stating that Gaozong was born at the Mountain Resort for Escaping the Heat; compiler Liu Fenggao knew this was wrong and told Zhenyong; Zhenyong reported it in audience; the Xuanzong Emperor was angry and censured and dismissed the Grand Councilors.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year the Jiaqing Emperor died. The Grand Council drafted the testamentary edict to say that the Qianlong Emperor had been born at the Mountain Resort. The compiler Liu Fenggao knew this was wrong and informed Zhenyong, who raised it in audience. The Daoguang Emperor was furious and censured and removed the Grand Councilors.

sentences.zh: 尋命振鏞為軍機大臣。

translations.literal: Soon afterward Zhenyong was appointed a Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Zhenyong was appointed to the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 宣宗治尚恭儉，振鏞小心謹慎，一守文法，最被倚任。

translations.literal: The Xuanzong Emperor's governance valued respectfulness and frugality; Zhenyong was cautious and careful, always adhering to regulations, and was most relied upon.
translations.idiomatic: The Daoguang Emperor prized respectful frugality in government. Zhenyong was cautious and scrupulous in observing regulations, and no one was more trusted.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，晉太子太傅、武英殿大學士。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daoguang he was advanced to Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent and grand secretary of the Wuying Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Daoguang reign he was promoted to grand tutor of the heir apparent and grand secretary of the Wuying Hall.

sentences.zh: 三年，萬壽節，幸萬壽山玉瀾堂，賜宴十五老臣，振鏞年齒居末，特命與宴繪像。

translations.literal: In the third year, on the Longevity Festival, the emperor visited the Yulan Hall on Longevity Hill and bestowed a banquet on fifteen aged ministers; Zhenyong was youngest in years, yet was specially ordered to attend the banquet and have his portrait painted.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on the emperor's birthday, he visited the Yulan Hall on Longevity Hill and feasted fifteen elderly ministers. Though Zhenyong was the youngest among them, he was specially commanded to attend the banquet and sit for a portrait.

sentences.zh: 四年，充上書房總師傅。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he served as chief tutor of the Upper Study.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was made chief tutor of the Upper Study.

sentences.zh: 六年，入直南書房。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he entered regular duty in the Southern Study.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he took up regular duty in the Southern Study.

sentences.zh: 七年，回疆平，晉太子太師。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, when the Western Regions were pacified, he was advanced to Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, after the pacification of the Western Regions, he was promoted to grand preceptor of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 八年，張格爾就擒，晉太傅，賜紫韁，圖形紫光閣，列功臣中。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, when Jahangir Khoja was captured, he was advanced to Grand Tutor, granted a purple bridle, and his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the meritorious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, after Jahangir Khoja was captured, he was made grand tutor, granted a purple bridle, and had his portrait placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the dynasty's meritorious officials.

sentences.zh: 振鏞具疏固辭，詔凡軍機大臣別繪一圖，以遂讓功之心，而彰輔弼之效。

translations.literal: Zhenyong submitted a memorial firmly declining; an edict ordered that every Grand Councilor be painted in a separate portrait, thereby fulfilling his wish to yield merit and displaying the effect of his assistance.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenyong submitted a memorial firmly declining the honor. The emperor ordered that each Grand Councilor be given a separate portrait, thereby honoring his wish to yield credit while making clear the value of his service.

sentences.zh: 御製贊曰：「親政之始，先進正人。

translations.literal: The emperor composed an encomium, saying: "At the beginning of personal rule, he first advanced upright men.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor composed an encomium that read: "At the start of his personal rule, he first advanced upright men.

sentences.zh: 密勿之地，心腹之臣。

translations.literal: In the place of intimate counsel, a trusted minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the innermost councils, a trusted confidant.

sentences.zh: 問學淵博，獻替精醇。

translations.literal: His learning was broad and deep; his remonstrance and counsel were refined and pure.
translations.idiomatic: His learning was broad and deep, and his counsel to the throne was refined and exact.

sentences.zh: 克勤克慎，首掌絲綸。」

translations.literal: Diligent and careful, he first held charge of imperial edicts."
translations.idiomatic: Diligent and careful, he was foremost in drafting imperial edicts."

sentences.zh: 親書以賜之。

translations.literal: He personally wrote it and bestowed it on him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wrote it in his own hand and bestowed it upon him.

sentences.zh: 十一年，以萬壽慶典賜雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, on the celebration of the Longevity Festival, he was granted double-eyed peacock feathers.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he received double-eyed peacock feathers in honor of the emperor's birthday celebration.

sentences.zh: 十五年，卒，年八十有一。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he died, aged eighty-one.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he died at the age of eighty-one.

sentences.zh: 自繕遺疏，附摺至十餘事。

translations.literal: He himself drafted a final memorial, with attached memorials on more than ten matters.
translations.idiomatic: He drafted his own final memorial, attaching more than ten supplementary memorials on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 上震悼，詔曰：「大學士曹振鏞，人品端方。

translations.literal: The emperor was deeply grieved and issued an edict saying: "Grand Secretary Cao Zhenyong's character was upright and correct.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was deeply grieved and issued an edict: "Grand Secretary Cao Zhenyong was upright in character.

sentences.zh: 自授軍機大臣以來，靖恭正直，歷久不渝。

translations.literal: Since his appointment as Grand Councilor, he had been respectful, upright, and unchanging over many years.
translations.idiomatic: From the time he joined the Grand Council he had been respectful and upright, and remained so through the years.

sentences.zh: 凡所陳奏，務得大體。

translations.literal: In all his memorials he sought to grasp the larger principles.
translations.idiomatic: In everything he submitted to the throne, he kept sight of the larger principles of governance.

sentences.zh: 前大學士劉統勳、硃珪，於乾隆、嘉慶中蒙皇祖、皇考鑑其品節，賜諡文正。

translations.literal: Former grand secretaries Liu Tongxun and Zhu Gui, in the Qianlong and Jiaqing reigns, had their character and integrity recognized by the emperor's grandfather and father, and were granted the posthumous title Wenzheng.
translations.idiomatic: Former grand secretaries Liu Tongxun and Zhu Gui had been recognized for their character by the Qianlong and Jiaqing emperors and granted the posthumous title Wenzheng.

sentences.zh: 曹振鏞實心任事，外貌訥然，而獻替不避嫌怨，朕深倚賴而人不知。

translations.literal: Cao Zhenyong served with a sincere heart; outwardly he seemed dull, yet in remonstrance and counsel he did not avoid enmity; I relied on him deeply while others did not know.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Zhenyong served with complete sincerity. Though he seemed dull in manner, he never shrank from candid counsel even when it bred resentment. I relied on him deeply, yet the world scarcely knew it.

sentences.zh: 揆諸諡法，足以當'正'字而無媿。

translations.literal: Measured against the rules of posthumous titles, he fully merits the character 'zheng' without shame.
translations.idiomatic: By the standards of posthumous titles, he fully merits the character zheng without question.

sentences.zh: 其予諡文正。」

translations.literal: Let him be given the posthumous title Wenzheng."
translations.idiomatic: Let him be granted the posthumous title Wenzheng."

sentences.zh: 入祀賢良祠。

translations.literal: He was entered for worship in the Shrine of Worthy Officials.
translations.idiomatic: He was enshrined in the Shrine of Worthy Officials.

sentences.zh: 擢次子恩★K9四品卿。

translations.literal: His second son Engang was promoted to a fourth-rank court official.
translations.idiomatic: His second son Engang was promoted to a fourth-rank court official.

sentences.zh: 振鏞歷事三朝，凡為學政者三，典鄉會試者各四。

translations.literal: Zhenyong served three reigns; he served three times as education commissioner and four times each as examiner of the provincial and metropolitan examinations.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenyong served three reigns, held the education commissionership three times, and presided over the provincial and metropolitan examinations four times each.

sentences.zh: 衡文惟遵功令，不取淹博才華之士。

translations.literal: In judging essays he only followed the examination regulations and did not select candidates of broad learning and literary brilliance.
translations.idiomatic: In examining candidates he adhered strictly to the examination regulations and did not favor men of broad learning or literary brilliance.

sentences.zh: 殿廷禦試，必預校閱，嚴於疵累忌諱，遂成風氣。

translations.literal: In palace imperial examinations he always took part in preliminary review, was strict about flaws and tabooed expressions, and thus established a prevailing practice.
translations.idiomatic: He always took part in reviewing palace examination papers, enforcing strict rules against flaws and tabooed expressions until this became the prevailing custom.

sentences.zh: 凡纂修會典、兩朝實錄、河工方略、明鑑、皇朝文穎、全唐文，皆為總裁。

translations.literal: In all compilations of the Collected Statutes, Veritable Records of two reigns, Records of River Works, Mirror of the Ming, Literary Collection of the Dynasty, and Complete Tang Prose, he served as chief editor.
translations.idiomatic: He served as chief editor of the Collected Statutes, the Veritable Records of two reigns, the Records of River Works, the Mirror of the Ming, the Literary Collection of the Dynasty, and the Complete Tang Prose.

sentences.zh: 駕謁諸陵及秋狝木蘭，每命留京辦事。

translations.literal: Whenever the emperor visited the imperial tombs or hunted at autumn hunt in Mulan, he was each time ordered to remain in the capital to handle affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the emperor visited the imperial tombs or went on the autumn hunt at Mulan, Zhenyong was left in the capital to manage affairs.

sentences.zh: 臨雍視學，命充直講。

translations.literal: When the emperor personally inspected study at the Imperial Academy, he was ordered to serve as lecturer on duty.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor personally inspected study at the Imperial Academy, he was appointed lecturer on duty.

sentences.zh: 恩眷之隆，時無與比。

translations.literal: The grandeur of imperial favor toward him had no equal in his time.
translations.idiomatic: The favor shown him had no equal in his day.

sentences.zh: 數請停罷不急工程，撙節糜費。

translations.literal: He repeatedly requested suspension of non-urgent projects and reduction of wasteful expenditures.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly urged the suspension of nonessential projects and the curbing of wasteful spending.

sentences.zh: 世以鹽筴起家，及改行淮北票法，舊商受損，振鏞曰：「焉有餓死之宰相家？」

translations.literal: The world knew his family had risen through the salt monopoly; when the Huai-north ticket system was adopted, old merchants suffered losses, and Zhenyong said: "How could there be a prime minister's household that starves?"
translations.idiomatic: His family was known to have risen through the salt trade. When the Huai-north ticket system was introduced and established merchants suffered losses, Zhenyong said, "Could a prime minister's household ever starve?"

sentences.zh: 卒贊成，世特以稱之。

translations.literal: In the end he approved it, and the world especially praised him for this.
translations.idiomatic: In the end he endorsed the reform, and posterity especially praised him for it.

sentences.zh: 文孚，字秋潭，博爾濟吉特氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Wen Fu, style name Qiutan, of the Borjigit clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Fu, whose style was Qiutan, was a Borjigit Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 由監生考授內閣中書，充軍機章京。

translations.literal: Through examination as a student of the Imperial Academy he was appointed secretary of the Grand Secretariat and served as a Grand Council clerk.
translations.idiomatic: Through the student-of-the-academy examination he was appointed a secretarial clerk of the Grand Secretariat and served on the Grand Council staff.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年，從那彥成赴陝西治軍需。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiaqing he followed Nayancheng to Shaanxi to manage military supplies.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of the Jiaqing reign he accompanied Nayancheng to Shaanxi to manage military supplies.

sentences.zh: 八年，隨扈秋狝，校射中四矢，賜花翎。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he accompanied the autumn hunt, hit four arrows in the archery trial, and was granted peacock feathers.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he accompanied the autumn hunt, scored four hits in the archery trial, and was granted peacock feathers.

sentences.zh: 十一年，以在直勤，擢四五品京堂，授內閣侍讀學士。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, for diligence on duty, he was promoted to a fourth- or fifth-rank capital official and appointed reader-in-waiting of the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, for his diligence on duty, he was promoted to a fourth- or fifth-rank capital post and made reader-in-waiting of the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 歷鴻臚寺卿、通政司副使。

translations.literal: He served successively as director of the Court of State Ceremonial and as vice commissioner of the Office of Transmission.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as director of the Court of State Ceremonial and as vice commissioner of the Office of Transmission.

sentences.zh: 命履勘綏遠城渾津、黑河鹼地改徵，及大青山牧廠餘地招墾事。

translations.literal: He was ordered to conduct on-site surveys of changing the tax assessment on alkaline lands at Hunjin and Heihe in Suiyuan City, and of recruiting settlers for remaining pasture lands of the Great Green Mountain herds.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to survey on site the reassessment of alkaline lands at Hunjin and Heihe near Suiyuan, and the recruitment of settlers for unused pasture lands on the Great Green Mountain.

sentences.zh: 十三年，予副都統銜，充西寧辦事大臣。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was given the rank of vice commander-in-chief and appointed commissioner for Xining affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he received the rank of vice commander-in-chief and was appointed commissioner for Xining affairs.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「青海蒙、番，重利輕命。

translations.literal: He memorialized, saying: "The Mongols and Tibetans of Qinghai value profit and slight life.
translations.idiomatic: In a memorial he wrote: "The Mongols and Tibetans of Qinghai value profit over life.

sentences.zh: 自來命盜諸案，一經罰服，怨仇消釋。

translations.literal: From old times in homicide and robbery cases, once a fine was paid and accepted, enmity was dissolved.
translations.idiomatic: In homicide and robbery cases, once a fine was paid and accepted, grievances were ordinarily laid to rest.

sentences.zh: 若必按律懲辦，不第犯事之家仇隙相尋，被害者心反觖望，相習成風，不可化誨。

translations.literal: If they must be punished according to law, not only will the families involved pursue vendettas, but the victims' hearts will instead become resentful; the practice becomes a custom and cannot be transformed by instruction.
translations.idiomatic: If every case were punished strictly under inland law, vendettas would multiply among the families involved, victims would grow resentful rather than satisfied, and the custom would become ingrained beyond reform by instruction.

sentences.zh: 溯蒙、番內附以來，雍正十一年大學士鄂爾泰等議纂番例頒行，聲明俟五年後始依內地律例辦理。

translations.literal: Tracing back since the Mongols and Tibetans submitted, in the eleventh year of Yongzheng Grand Secretary Ortai and others deliberated compiling Tibetan regulations for promulgation, declaring that only after five years would inland statutes be applied.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Mongols and Tibetans submitted, in the eleventh year of the Yongzheng reign Grand Secretary Ortai and others had compiled frontier regulations for promulgation, declaring that inland statutes would apply only after five years.

sentences.zh: 乾隆年間疊經展限，茲复奉命詳議。

translations.literal: During the Qianlong reign extensions were repeatedly granted; now he was again ordered to deliberate in detail.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qianlong reign the deadline had been extended again and again; now he was again ordered to deliberate the matter in detail.

sentences.zh: 臣以為番、民糾結滋擾，或情同叛逆，或關係邊陲大局，自應從嚴懲辦。

translations.literal: Your servant considers that when Tibetans and common people entangle and cause disturbances, if the circumstances resemble rebellion or concern the larger situation on the frontier, they should naturally be punished severely.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant holds that when Tibetans and local people entangle in disturbances, cases resembling rebellion or bearing on frontier security should naturally be punished severely.

sentences.zh: 若其自相殘殺及盜竊之案，向以罰服完結，相安巳久。

translations.literal: If they are cases of mutual killing among themselves or theft, they have long been settled by fines and acceptance, and peace has endured.
translations.idiomatic: Cases of mutual killing among themselves or ordinary theft have long been settled by fines, and this arrangement has kept the peace.

sentences.zh: 必繩以內地法律，轉恐愚昧野番，群疑滋懼，非綏服邊氓之道。」

translations.literal: If they must be bound by inland law, I fear the ignorant frontier Tibetans will grow collectively suspicious and fearful; this is not the way to pacify frontier peoples."
translations.idiomatic: To bind them strictly to inland law would only make ignorant frontier Tibetans grow suspicious and fearful, which is not the way to pacify border peoples."

sentences.zh: 疏入，下軍機大臣議行。

translations.literal: When the memorial was submitted, it was sent down to the Grand Council for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial reached the throne, it was referred to the Grand Council for deliberation and implementation.

sentences.zh: 十六年，召回京，授鑲白旗滿洲副都統。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was recalled to the capital and appointed vice commander-in-chief of the Manchu Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he was recalled to the capital and appointed vice commander-in-chief of the Manchu Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 偕內閣學士阮元勘議山西鹽務，疏請停止吉蘭泰鹽官運，改並潞商引額，以潞引之有餘，補吉課之不足，吉鹽許民撈販，限制水運至皇甫川而止，下部議行。

translations.literal: Together with Grand Secretary Ruan Yuan he surveyed and deliberated on Shanxi salt affairs, memorializing to stop official transport of Jilantai salt, merge it into the salt quotas of Lu merchants, use the surplus of Lu quotas to make up the shortfall of Jilantai revenue, permit the people to scoop and sell Jilantai salt, and limit water transport to Huangfu River only; the ministries deliberated and implemented.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Grand Secretary Ruan Yuan he investigated Shanxi salt affairs and memorialized to end official transport of Jilantai salt, merging its quota into that of the Lu merchants so that Lu surpluses could cover Jilantai shortfalls, while allowing locals to scoop and sell Jilantai salt and limiting water transport to Huangfu River. The ministries approved and implemented the plan.

sentences.zh: 尋授內閣學士，遷刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was appointed grand secretary and transferred to vice minister of the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was made a grand secretary and transferred to vice minister of justice.

sentences.zh: 十八年，緣事降調，予二等侍衛，命赴山東治軍需。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, on account of an affair he was demoted, given the post of second-rank bodyguard, and ordered to Shandong to manage military supplies.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he was demoted over an affair, given the post of second-rank bodyguard, and sent to Shandong to manage military supplies.

sentences.zh: 复授內閣學士，歷山海關副都統、馬蘭鎮總兵、錦州副都統。

translations.literal: He was again appointed grand secretary and served successively as vice commander-in-chief at Shanhaiguan, commander at Malan Garrison, and vice commander-in-chief at Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was again made a grand secretary and served in turn as vice commander-in-chief at Shanhaiguan, commander at Malan Garrison, and vice commander-in-chief at Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 二十年，召授刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he was summoned and appointed vice minister of the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he was recalled and appointed vice minister of justice.

sentences.zh: 二十四年。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year,

sentences.zh: 命在軍機大臣上學習行走。

translations.literal: he was ordered to study and serve under the Grand Councilors.
translations.idiomatic: he was ordered to study and serve on the Grand Council staff.

sentences.zh: 偕侍郎帥承瀛赴山東鞫獄，並勘蘭儀決口，督濬引河。

translations.literal: Together with Vice Minister Shuai Chengying he went to Shandong to try cases and also surveyed the breach at Lanyi, supervising dredging of the diversion channel.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Vice Minister Shuai Chengying he went to Shandong to try cases, surveyed the breach at Lanyi, and supervised dredging of the diversion channel.

sentences.zh: 次年春，竣工，予議敘。

translations.literal: The following spring the work was completed, and he was granted consideration for reward.
translations.idiomatic: The following spring the work was completed, and he was recommended for commendation.

sentences.zh: 調戶部，又調工部，擢左都御史。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue, then to the Ministry of Works, and promoted to left censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue, then to the Ministry of Works, and promoted to left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 宣宗即位，以樞臣撰擬遺詔不慎，先後罷直，文孚獨留。

translations.literal: When the Xuanzong Emperor ascended the throne, because the Grand Councilors had drafted the testamentary edict carelessly, they were successively dismissed from regular duty; Wen Fu alone remained.
translations.idiomatic: When the Daoguang Emperor ascended the throne, the Grand Councilors were removed one after another for carelessly drafting the testamentary edict, but Wen Fu alone remained on the council.

sentences.zh: 道光二年，命往陝西按鞫渭南縣民柳全璧毆斃人命獄，論知縣徐潤受人囑託、疏脫正兇、事後得贓，枷號兩月，遣戍伊犁；

translations.literal: In the second year of Daoguang he was ordered to Shaanxi to try the homicide case in which the commoner Liu Quanbi of Weinan County was beaten to death; the magistrate Xu Run was judged to have accepted entreaties, released the principal culprit, and afterward received bribes; he was cangued for two months and banished to Yili;
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Daoguang reign he was sent to Shaanxi to try the case of Liu Quanbi of Weinan County, beaten to death. Magistrate Xu Run was found to have accepted entreaties, let the principal culprit go, and taken bribes afterward. He was cangued for two months and banished to Yili;

sentences.zh: 升任西安知府鄧廷楨偏執枉縱，訊無貪酷，革職免發遣；

translations.literal: the promoted Xi'an prefect Deng Tingzhen was judged to have been partial and wrongly lenient; inquiry found no greed or cruelty, and he was dismissed from office but exempted from banishment;
translations.idiomatic: Xi'an Prefect Deng Tingzhen, who had been promoted in the meantime, was found partial and wrongly lenient, though inquiry uncovered no corruption or cruelty. He was dismissed but exempted from banishment;

sentences.zh: 巡撫硃勳失察，議革職，降四五品京堂。

translations.literal: the governor Zhu Xun was judged negligent in oversight, recommended for dismissal from office, and demoted to a fourth- or fifth-rank capital official.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Zhu Xun was found negligent in oversight, recommended for dismissal, and demoted to a fourth- or fifth-rank capital post.

sentences.zh: 四年，仁宗實錄成，加太子太保。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, when the Veritable Records of Renzong were completed, he was given the additional title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, after the Veritable Records of the Jiaqing Emperor were completed, he received the additional title of grand guardian of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 南河阻運，詔責減黃蓄清；

translations.literal: Transport on the Southern Canal was blocked, and an edict rebuked officials for failing to reduce the Yellow River flow and store clear water;
translations.idiomatic: When transport on the Southern Canal was blocked, an edict rebuked officials for failing to reduce Yellow River inflow and store clear water;

sentences.zh: 至十一月​​洪湖水多，啟壩而高堰、山盱石工潰決，命文孚偕尚書汪廷珍馳往按治，奏劾河督張文浩於禦黃壩應閉不閉，五壩應開不開，湖水過多，致石工掣塌萬餘丈，請遣戍伊犁；

translations.literal: by the eleventh month Hong Lake water was abundant, sluices were opened, and the stone works at Gaoyan and Shanyu burst; Wen Fu was ordered together with Minister Wang Tingzhen to hurry there to investigate and remedy; they memorialized impeaching Director-General Zhang Wenhao for not closing the Yellow River control sluice when it should have been closed and not opening the five sluices when they should have been opened, so that lake water was excessive and caused more than ten thousand zhang of stone works to collapse; they requested banishment to Yili;
translations.idiomatic: By the eleventh month Hong Lake was overfull, sluices were opened, and the stone works at Gaoyan and Shanyu collapsed. Wen Fu and Minister Wang Tingzhen were sent posthaste to investigate. They impeached Director-General Zhang Wenhao for leaving the Yellow River control sluice closed when it should have been shut and the five sluices unopened when they should have been opened, allowing so much lake water that more than ten thousand zhang of stonework collapsed. They recommended banishing him to Yili;

sentences.zh: 兩江總督孫玉庭徇隱回護，交部嚴議。

translations.literal: the Liangjiang governor-general Sun Yuting was judged to have concealed and shielded wrongdoing, and the case was referred to the ministries for severe deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Liangjiang Governor-General Sun Yuting was found to have concealed and shielded wrongdoing, and the case was referred to the ministries for severe deliberation.

sentences.zh: 議於禦黃壩外添建三壩，鉗束黃流。

translations.literal: They proposed building three additional sluices outside the Yellow River control sluice to restrain the Yellow flow.
translations.idiomatic: They proposed building three additional sluices beyond the Yellow River control sluice to restrain the Yellow River current.

sentences.zh: 壩內外及束清、運口各壩兩岸築纖道，多作土壩，挑濬長河，幫培堤身，以利漕行。

translations.literal: Inside and outside the sluices and on both banks of the Clear-Water control and transport mouth sluices they proposed building towpaths, making many earthen dams, dredging the long channel, and reinforcing embankments to benefit grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: They proposed building towpaths on both banks at the sluices inside and outside the control works and at the clear-water and transport mouths, constructing many earthen dams, dredging the main channel, and reinforcing embankments to aid the grain transport.

sentences.zh: 速挑引河，引清入運；

translations.literal: quickly dredge the diversion channel to lead clear water into the transport canal;
translations.idiomatic: Dredge the diversion channel quickly to lead clear water into the transport canal;

sentences.zh: 堵閉束清壩，杜黃入湖；

translations.literal: block the Clear-Water control sluice to stop Yellow water entering the lake;
translations.idiomatic: block the clear-water control sluice to keep Yellow River water out of the lake;

sentences.zh: 又議覆侍郎硃士彥條陳五事，由河臣勘辦。

translations.literal: they also deliberated on Vice Minister Zhu Shiyan's five-point memorial, to be surveyed and handled by the river officials.
translations.idiomatic: they also approved Vice Minister Zhu Shiyan's five-point memorial for investigation and implementation by the river officials.

sentences.zh: 疏上，並依議行。

translations.literal: When the memorial was submitted, all proposals were approved and implemented.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial reached the throne, all proposals were approved and carried out.

sentences.zh: 命文孚等回京，責嚴烺、魏元煜辦理，而引黃濟運仍不得要領，河、漕交困。

translations.literal: Wen Fu and others were ordered back to the capital, and Yan Liang and Wei Yuanyu were charged with handling matters, yet diverting Yellow water to aid transport still did not grasp the essentials, and both river control and grain transport were in distress.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Fu and his colleagues were recalled to the capital, and Yan Liang and Wei Yuanyu were charged with carrying out the work, but diverting Yellow River water to aid transport still failed to succeed, leaving both river control and the grain transport system in distress.

sentences.zh: 八年，回疆底定，首逆就擒，晉太子太傅，賜紫韁，繪像紫光閣，御製贊有「和而不同，公正以清」之褒。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the Western Regions were settled, the chief rebel was captured, he was advanced to Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent, granted a purple bridle, and his portrait was painted in the Hall of Purple Splendor; the imperial encomium praised him with the words "harmonious yet not conforming, upright and thereby clear."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, after the Western Regions were pacified and the chief rebel captured, he was promoted to grand tutor of the heir apparent, granted a purple bridle, and had his portrait placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor. The emperor's encomium praised him with the words, "harmonious yet not conforming, upright and thereby clear."

sentences.zh: 十一年，以吏部尚書協辦大學士。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he served as minister of the Ministry of Personnel and assistant grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he served as minister of personnel and assistant grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 十四年，拜東閣大學士，管理吏部。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was appointed grand secretary of the Eastern Pavilion and placed in charge of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was made grand secretary of the Eastern Pavilion and put in charge of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 十五年，轉文淵閣大學士。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was transferred to grand secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was transferred to grand secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 以疾請解職，優詔慰諭，許罷直軍機。

translations.literal: On account of illness he requested release from office; a gracious edict comforted and instructed him, and he was permitted to cease regular duty on the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: When illness led him to request retirement, a gracious edict comforted him and allowed him to leave regular duty on the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 十六年，致仕。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he retired.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he retired from office.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，卒，贈太保，諡文敬。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he died; he was posthumously granted Grand Guardian and given the posthumous title Wenjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he died. He was posthumously awarded the title of grand guardian and given the posthumous name Wenjing.

sentences.zh: 英和，字煦齋，索綽絡氏，滿洲正白旗人，尚書德保子。

translations.literal: Ying He, style name Xuzhai, of the Suochalu clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner and son of Minister Debao.
translations.idiomatic: Ying He, whose style was Xuzhai, was a Suochalu Manchu of the Plain White Banner and the son of the minister Debao.

sentences.zh: 少有俊才，和珅欲妻以女，德保不可。

translations.literal: When young he had outstanding talent; Heshen wished to marry him to his daughter, but Debao would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: As a youth he showed outstanding talent. Heshen wished to marry him to his daughter, but Debao refused.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十八年，成進士，選庶吉士，授編修，累遷侍讀。

translations.literal: In the fifty-eighth year of Qianlong he passed the metropolitan examination, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, appointed compiler, and successively promoted to reader-in-waiting.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-eighth year of the Qianlong reign he passed the metropolitan examination, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, was appointed compiler, and rose in succession to reader-in-waiting.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶三年，大考二等，擢侍讀學士。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jiaqing, in the grand examination he placed second class and was promoted to junior tutor in the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of the Jiaqing reign he placed second class in the palace examination and was made junior tutor in the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 洎仁宗親政。

translations.literal: When the Jiaqing Emperor assumed personal rule.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jiaqing Emperor assumed personal rule,

sentences.zh: 知其拒婚事，嘉焉，遂鄉用，累遷內閣學士。

translations.literal: Knowing of his refusal of the marriage alliance, the emperor approved, and thereupon favored employing him, repeatedly promoting him to grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: learning that he had refused the marriage alliance, the emperor approved and thereupon favored employing him, repeatedly promoting him until he reached grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 五年，授禮部侍郎，兼副都統。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed vice minister of Rites and concurrently vice commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was appointed vice minister of Rites and concurrently vice commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 六年，充內務府大臣，調戶部。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he served as minister of the Imperial Household and was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he served as minister of the Imperial Household and was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 以不到旗署為儀親王所糾，罷副都統。

translations.literal: Because he did not report to the banner yamen he was impeached by Prince Yi and removed from the vice commandership.
translations.idiomatic: Because he failed to report to the banner yamen, he was impeached by Prince Yi and stripped of the vice commandership.

sentences.zh: 七年，直南書房。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he served on regular duty in the Southern Library.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he served on regular duty in the Southern Library.

sentences.zh: 扈蹕木蘭，射鹿以獻，賜黃馬褂。

translations.literal: Accompanying the imperial procession to Mulan, he shot a deer and presented it; he was granted a yellow riding jacket.
translations.idiomatic: While accompanying the imperial procession to Mulan, he shot a deer and presented it to the emperor and was granted a yellow riding jacket.

sentences.zh: 授翰林院掌院學士。

translations.literal: He was appointed chancellor of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed chancellor of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 九年，帝幸翰林院，賜一品服，加太子少保，命在軍機大臣上學習行走。

translations.literal: In the ninth year the emperor visited the Hanlin Academy, bestowed first-rank robes on him, added the title junior guardian of the heir apparent, and ordered him to learn by serving among the Grand Councilors.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year the emperor visited the Hanlin Academy, bestowed first-rank robes on him, added the title of junior guardian of the heir apparent, and ordered him to learn by serving among the Grand Councilors.

sentences.zh: 時詔稽巡幸五台典禮，英和疏言教匪甫平，民未蘇息，請俟數年後再議，上嘉納之。

translations.literal: At that time an edict ordered examination of the rites for imperial tours to Mount Wutai; Ying He memorialized that the teaching rebels had only just been suppressed and the people had not yet recovered, requesting that the matter be reconsidered after several years; the emperor praised and accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: At that time an edict ordered a review of the rites for imperial tours to Mount Wutai. Ying He memorialized that the teaching rebels had only just been suppressed and the people had not yet recovered, and asked that the matter be reconsidered after several years. The emperor praised and accepted his proposal.

sentences.zh: 尋自請獨對，論大學士劉權之徇情慾保薦軍機章京袁煦，上不悅，兩斥之。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he requested a private audience and discussed how Grand Secretary Liu Quanzhi showed partiality in seeking to protect and recommend Grand Council clerk Yuan Xu; the emperor was displeased and reproached both men.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he requested a private audience and charged that Grand Secretary Liu Quanzhi had shown partiality in seeking to protect and recommend Grand Council clerk Yuan Xu. The emperor was displeased and reproached them both.

sentences.zh: 遂罷直書房、軍機，降太僕寺卿。

translations.literal: He was then removed from regular duty in the library and on the Grand Council and demoted to director of the Court of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: He was then removed from regular duty in the Southern Library and on the Grand Council and demoted to director of the Court of the Imperial Stud.

sentences.zh: 歷內閣學士，理籓​​院、工部侍郎。

translations.literal: He served as grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat and vice minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs and of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He served as grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat and as vice minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs and of the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 數奉使出按事，河東鹽課歸入地丁，而蒙古鹽侵越內地，命偕內閣學士初彭齡往會巡撫察議。

translations.literal: Several times he was sent on imperial commission to investigate affairs; the salt levies of Hedong had been incorporated into the land tax, but Mongol salt was encroaching on the interior, and he was ordered together with Grand Secretary Chu Pengling to join the governor in investigating and deliberating.
translations.idiomatic: Several times he was sent on imperial commission to investigate affairs. The salt levies of Hedong had been incorporated into the land tax, but Mongol salt was encroaching on the interior, so he was ordered together with Grand Secretary Chu Pengling to join the governor in investigating and deliberating.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「非禁水運不能限制蒙鹽，非設官商不能杜絕私販。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Without prohibiting transport by water, Mongol salt cannot be restricted; without establishing official merchants, private trafficking cannot be cut off.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Without prohibiting transport by water, Mongol salt cannot be restricted; without establishing official merchants, private trafficking cannot be eliminated.

sentences.zh: 請阿拉善鹽祗由陸路行銷，河東鹽仍改商運。

translations.literal: I request that Alashan salt be sold only by land routes and that Hedong salt again be converted to merchant transport.
translations.idiomatic: I request that Alashan salt be sold only by land routes and that Hedong salt again be converted to merchant transport.

sentences.zh: 吉蘭泰鹽池所產亦招商運辦。」

translations.literal: Salt produced at the Jilantai salt ponds should also be opened to merchant transport."
translations.idiomatic: Salt produced at the Jilantai salt ponds should also be opened to merchant transport."

sentences.zh: 事詳鹽法志。

translations.literal: The matter is detailed in the Treatise on Salt Laws.
translations.idiomatic: The matter is detailed in the Treatise on Salt Laws.

sentences.zh: 兼左翼總兵，復為內務府大臣。

translations.literal: He concurrently served as commander of the Left Wing and again became minister of the Imperial Household.
translations.idiomatic: He concurrently served as commander of the Left Wing and again became minister of the Imperial Household.

sentences.zh: 十二年，偕侍郎蔣予蒲查南河料物加價，議準增添，仍示限制，從之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, together with Vice Minister Jiang Yupu he investigated price increases for materials on the Southern Rivers; increases were approved but limits were still indicated, and the proposal was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, together with Vice Minister Jiang Yupu, he investigated price increases for materials on the Southern Rivers. Increases were approved but limits were still set, and the proposal was adopted.

sentences.zh: 复直南書房。

translations.literal: He again served on regular duty in the Southern Library.
translations.idiomatic: He again served on regular duty in the Southern Library.

sentences.zh: 十三年，命暫在軍機大臣上行走，調戶部、武英殿。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was ordered temporarily to serve among the Grand Councilors and was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue and the Wuying Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was ordered temporarily to serve among the Grand Councilors and was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue and the Wuying Hall.

sentences.zh: 進高宗聖訓廟號有誤，坐降調內閣學士。

translations.literal: In submitting the temple name for the Qianlong Emperor's sacred instructions he made an error and was demoted to grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In submitting the temple name for the Qianlong Emperor's sacred instructions he made an error and was demoted to grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 尋遷禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was transferred to vice minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was transferred to vice minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 十八年，隨扈熱河，會林清逆黨為變，命先回京署步軍統領。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, accompanying the imperial procession to Rehe, when Lin Qing's rebel faction rose in revolt he was ordered to return first to the capital and act as commander of the metropolitan banner brigade.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, while accompanying the imperial procession to Rehe, he was caught up in Lin Qing's rebellion and ordered to return first to the capital and act as commander of the metropolitan banner brigade.

sentences.zh: 擒林清於黃村西宋家莊，實授步軍統領、工部尚書。

translations.literal: Lin Qing was captured at Songjiazhuang west of Huangcun, and Ying He was formally appointed commander of the metropolitan banner brigade and minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Qing was captured at Songjiazhuang west of Huangcun, and Ying He was formally appointed commander of the metropolitan banner brigade and minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 滑縣平，复太子少保。

translations.literal: When Huaxian was pacified, he again received the title junior guardian of the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: When Huaxian was pacified, he again received the title of junior guardian of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 十九年。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year,

sentences.zh: 將開捐例，廷議不一。

translations.literal: As a sale of offices by subscription was about to be opened, court discussion was divided.
translations.idiomatic: as a sale of offices by subscription was about to be opened, court discussion was divided.

sentences.zh: 偕大學士曹振鏞等覆議，獨上疏曰：「理財之道，不外開源節流。

translations.literal: Together with Grand Secretary Cao Zhenyong and others he replied to the deliberation, but alone submitted a memorial saying: "The way to manage finances is nothing beyond expanding revenue and cutting expenditure.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Grand Secretary Cao Zhenyong and others he replied to the deliberation, but alone submitted a memorial saying: "The way to manage finances is nothing beyond expanding revenue and cutting expenditure.

sentences.zh: 大捐為權宜之計，本朝屢經舉行。

translations.literal: Large-scale subscription sales are an expedient measure that our dynasty has repeatedly undertaken.
translations.idiomatic: Large-scale subscription sales are an expedient measure that our dynasty has repeatedly undertaken.

sentences.zh: 但觀前事，即知此次未必大效。

translations.literal: But observing past events suffices to show that this occasion may not be greatly effective.
translations.idiomatic: But observing past events suffices to show that this occasion may not be greatly effective.

sentences.zh: 竊以開捐不如節用，開捐暫時取給，節用歲有所餘。

translations.literal: I consider that opening subscription sales is inferior to economizing: subscription sales supply needs temporarily, while economizing yields surplus year by year.
translations.idiomatic: I consider that opening subscription sales is inferior to economizing: subscription sales supply needs temporarily, while economizing yields surplus year by year.

sentences.zh: 請嗣後謁陵，或三年五年一舉行，民力可紓。

translations.literal: I request that hereafter imperial tomb visitations be held once every three or five years, so that the people's strength may be eased.
translations.idiomatic: I request that hereafter imperial tomb visitations be held once every three or five years, so that the people's strength may be eased.

sentences.zh: 木蘭秋狝，為我朝家法，然蒙古迥迥昔比，亦請間歲一行，於外籓生計所全實大​​。

translations.literal: The autumn hunt at Mulan is a house law of our dynasty, but the Mongols are far poorer than in former times; I also request that it be held in alternate years—a measure that would greatly preserve the livelihood of the outer dependencies.
translations.idiomatic: The autumn hunt at Mulan is a house law of our dynasty, but the Mongols are far poorer than in former times; I also request that it be held in alternate years—a measure that would greatly preserve the livelihood of the outer dependencies.

sentences.zh: 各處工程奉旨停止，每歲可省數十萬至百餘萬不等。

translations.literal: Engineering projects everywhere that the edict had ordered stopped could save several hundred thousand to more than a million taels each year.
translations.idiomatic: Engineering projects everywhere that edicts had ordered stopped could save several hundred thousand to more than a million taels each year.

sentences.zh: 天下無名之費甚多，苟於國體無傷，不得任其糜費。

translations.literal: Unnamed expenses throughout the empire are many; if they do not harm the dignity of the state, they must not be allowed to waste funds wantonly.
translations.idiomatic: Unnamed expenses throughout the empire are many; if they do not harm the dignity of the state, they must not be allowed to waste funds wantonly.

sentences.zh: 即如裁撤武職名糧，未必能禁武官不役兵丁，而驟增養廉百餘萬，應請敕下部臣詳查正項經費外，歷年增出各款，可裁則裁，可減則減，積久行之，國計日裕。

translations.literal: For example, abolishing nominal rations for military posts may not necessarily prevent military officers from requisitioning soldiers, yet suddenly increasing integrity-nurturing allowances by more than a million—I request an imperial order to the ministry to examine in detail, beyond regular budget items, all the additional items accumulated over the years; what can be cut, cut; what can be reduced, reduce; practiced over time, the state finances will daily grow ample.
translations.idiomatic: For example, abolishing nominal rations for military posts may not necessarily prevent military officers from requisitioning soldiers, yet suddenly increasing integrity-nurturing allowances by more than a million—I request an imperial order to the ministry to examine in detail, beyond regular budget items, all the additional items accumulated over the years; what can be cut, cut; what can be reduced, reduce; practiced over time, the state finances will daily grow ample.

sentences.zh: 至開源之計，不得以事涉言利，概行斥駁。

translations.literal: As for plans to expand revenue, one must not reject them outright merely because the matter touches on speaking of profit.
translations.idiomatic: As for plans to expand revenue, one must not reject them outright merely because the matter touches on speaking of profit.

sentences.zh: 新疆歲支兵餉百數十萬，為內地之累，其地金銀礦久經封閉，開之而礦苗旺盛，足敷兵餉；

translations.literal: Xinjiang annually expends more than a million taels in military pay, a burden on the interior; the gold and silver mines there have long been sealed—if opened and the ore veins flourish, they would suffice to cover military pay;
translations.idiomatic: Xinjiang annually expends more than a million taels in military pay, a burden on the interior; the gold and silver mines there have long been sealed—if opened and the ore veins flourish, they would suffice to cover military pay;

sentences.zh: 各省礦廠，亦應詳查興辦。

translations.literal: mines in each province should also be investigated in detail and developed.
translations.idiomatic: mines in each province should also be investigated in detail and developed.

sentences.zh: 又戶部入官地畝，請嚴催昇科，於國用亦有裨益。」

translations.literal: Also, with regard to land acres confiscated to the Ministry of Revenue, I request strict urging to bring them onto the tax rolls, which would also benefit state revenue."
translations.idiomatic: Also, with regard to land acres confiscated to the Ministry of Revenue, I request strict urging to bring them onto the tax rolls, which would also benefit state revenue."

sentences.zh: 疏入，詔以名糧巳飭覈辦，開礦流弊滋多，仍依眾議，豫工事例遂開。

translations.literal: When the memorial was submitted, an edict stated that nominal rations had already been ordered investigated, and that opening mines would multiply abuses; still following the majority opinion, the subscription regulations for Henan engineering were thereupon opened.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial was submitted, an edict stated that nominal rations had already been ordered investigated and that opening mines would multiply abuses; still following the majority opinion, the subscription regulations for Henan engineering were thereupon opened.

sentences.zh: 是歲調吏部，復命暫在軍機大臣上行走。

translations.literal: That year he was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel and again ordered temporarily to serve among the Grand Councilors.
translations.idiomatic: That year he was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel and again ordered temporarily to serve among the Grand Councilors.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，宣宗即位，命為軍機大臣，調戶部。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, when the Daoguang Emperor ascended the throne, he was appointed Grand Councilor and transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year, when the Daoguang Emperor ascended the throne, he was appointed Grand Councilor and transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 宣宗方銳意求治，英和竭誠獻替。

translations.literal: The Daoguang Emperor was then keen to seek good governance, and Ying He devoted himself wholeheartedly in offering counsel and replacements.
translations.idiomatic: The Daoguang Emperor was then keen to seek good governance, and Ying He devoted himself wholeheartedly to offering counsel and replacements.

sentences.zh: 面陳各省府、州、縣養廉不敷辦公，莫不取給陋規，請查明分別存革，示以限制。

translations.literal: In audience he stated that integrity-nurturing allowances for prefectures, departments, and counties in each province were insufficient for official business and all were supplied from irregular fees; he requested investigation to distinguish what should be kept or abolished and to set limits.
translations.idiomatic: In audience he stated that integrity-nurturing allowances for prefectures, departments, and counties in each province were insufficient for official business and all were supplied from irregular fees; he requested investigation to distinguish what should be kept or abolished and to set limits.

sentences.zh: 上採其言，下疆吏詳議，而中外臣工多言其不可，詔停其議，遂罷直軍機，專任部務。

translations.literal: The emperor adopted his words and sent them down to the frontier officials for detailed deliberation, but officials at court and in the provinces largely said it was impossible; an edict halted the deliberation, and he was removed from regular duty on the Grand Council and devoted himself solely to ministry affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor adopted his words and sent them down to the frontier officials for detailed deliberation, but officials at court and in the provinces largely said it was impossible. An edict halted the deliberation, and he was removed from regular duty on the Grand Council and devoted himself solely to ministry affairs.

sentences.zh: 道光二年，以戶部尚書協辦大學士，兼翰林院掌院學士。

translations.literal: In the second year of Daoguang he served as coordinating grand secretary with the rank of minister of Revenue and concurrently as chancellor of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Daoguang reign he served as coordinating grand secretary with the rank of minister of Revenue and concurrently as chancellor of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 四年，仁宗實錄成，加太子太保。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, when the Veritable Records of the Jiaqing Emperor were completed, he was given the additional title grand guardian of the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, when the Veritable Records of the Jiaqing Emperor were completed, he received the additional title of grand guardian of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 五年，洪澤湖決，阻運道，河、漕交敝，詔籌海運，疆臣率拘牽成例，以為不可。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Hong Lake burst, blocking the transport route; river control and the grain transport system were both in distress; an edict ordered planning for sea transport, but frontier governors mostly clung to precedent and deemed it impossible.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Hong Lake burst, blocking the transport route, and river control and the grain transport system were both in distress. An edict ordered planning for sea transport, but frontier governors mostly clung to precedent and deemed it impossible.

sentences.zh: 英和奏陳海運、折漕二事為救時之計，越日復上疏，略謂：「河、漕不能兼顧，惟有暫停河運以治河，​​僱募海船以利運，而任事諸臣未敢議行者，一則慮商船到津，難以交卸；

translations.literal: Ying He memorialized that sea transport and conversion of tribute grain were measures to save the time, and the next day submitted another memorial, stating roughly: "River control and the grain transport system cannot both be cared for at once; there is no choice but temporarily to halt river transport to control the river and hire sea vessels to aid transport; yet the officials charged with the work did not dare propose action—on one hand fearing that when merchant vessels reached Tianjin, unloading would be difficult;
translations.idiomatic: Ying He memorialized that sea transport and conversion of tribute grain were measures to save the time, and the next day submitted another memorial, stating roughly: "River control and the grain transport system cannot both be cared for at once; there is no choice but temporarily to halt river transport to control the river and hire sea vessels to aid transport. Yet the officials charged with the work did not dare propose action—on one hand fearing that when merchant vessels reached Tianjin, unloading would be difficult;

sentences.zh: 一則慮海運既行，漕運員弁、旗丁、水手難以安插。」

translations.literal: on the other fearing that once sea transport was instituted, grain transport officials, banner transport personnel, and boatmen would be hard to resettle."
translations.idiomatic: on the other fearing that once sea transport was instituted, grain transport officials, banner transport personnel, and boatmen would be hard to resettle."

sentences.zh: 因陳防弊處置之策甚悉。

translations.literal: He thereupon set forth measures to guard against abuses in full detail.
translations.idiomatic: He thereupon set forth measures to guard against abuses in full detail.

sentences.zh: 詔下各省妥議，仍多諉為未便，惟江蘇巡撫陶澍力行之，撥蘇、松、常、鎮、太五屬漕米，以河船分次海運。

translations.literal: An edict was sent down to each province for proper deliberation; most still pleaded inconvenience, but Jiangsu Governor Tao Shu vigorously implemented it, allocating tribute grain from the five subordinate districts of Su, Song, Chang, Zhen, and Tai and using river boats in separate batches for sea transport.
translations.idiomatic: An edict was sent down to each province for proper deliberation; most still pleaded inconvenience, but Jiangsu Governor Tao Shu vigorously implemented it, allocating tribute grain from the five subordinate districts of Su, Song, Chang, Zhen, and Tai and using river boats in separate batches for sea transport.

sentences.zh: 六年八月，悉數抵天津，上大悅，詔嘉英和創議，予議敘，特賜紫韁以旌異之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the sixth year all arrived at Tianjin; the emperor was greatly pleased; an edict praised Ying He for initiating the proposal, granted him recognition in service evaluation, and specially bestowed a purple bridle to mark his distinction.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the sixth year all arrived at Tianjin. The emperor was greatly pleased. An edict praised Ying He for initiating the proposal, granted him recognition in service evaluation, and specially bestowed a purple bridle to mark his distinction.

sentences.zh: 張格爾犯回疆，英和疏陳進兵方略，籌備軍需，並舉長齡、武隆阿可任事，多被採用。

translations.literal: When Jahangir Khoja invaded the Western Regions, Ying He memorialized military strategy, provisioned army supplies, and also recommended Changling and Wulong'a as capable of handling affairs; much was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: When Jahangir Khoja invaded the Western Regions, Ying He memorialized on military strategy, provisioned army supplies, and also recommended Changling and Wulong'a as capable of handling affairs; much of his advice was adopted.

sentences.zh: 七年，奏商人請於易州開採銀礦，詔斥其冒昧。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he memorialized that merchants requested opening silver mines in Yizhou; an edict reprimanded him for presumption.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he memorialized that merchants requested opening silver mines in Yizhou; an edict reprimanded him for presumption.

sentences.zh: 調理籓院，罷南書房、內務府大臣。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Court of Colonial Affairs and removed from the Southern Library and the Imperial Household.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the Court of Colonial Affairs and removed from the Southern Library and the Imperial Household.

sentences.zh: 未幾，坐家人增租擾累，出為熱河都統。

translations.literal: Before long, because his household servants raised rents and caused trouble, he was sent out as governor-general of Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, because his household servants raised rents and caused trouble, he was sent out as governor-general of Rehe.

sentences.zh: 八年，命勘南河工程。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was ordered to inspect Southern River engineering projects.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was ordered to inspect Southern River engineering projects.

sentences.zh: 回疆平，复太子少保。

translations.literal: When the Western Regions were pacified, he again received the title junior guardian of the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: When the Western Regions were pacified, he again received the title of junior guardian of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 授寧夏將軍，以病請解職，允之。

translations.literal: He was appointed general of Ningxia; on account of illness he requested release from office, and permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed general of Ningxia; on account of illness he requested release from office, and permission was granted.

sentences.zh: 初，營萬年吉地於寶華峪，命英和監修，嘗從容言漢文帝薄葬事，上稱善，議於舊制有所裁省，工竣，孝穆皇后奉安，優予獎敘。

translations.literal: Initially, when the eternal auspicious site was being built at Baohua Valley, Ying He was ordered to supervise construction; he once calmly spoke of Emperor Wen of Han's frugal burial; the emperor praised it, and it was discussed that the old regulations should be reduced somewhat; when the work was completed and Empress Xiaomu was enshrined, he received preferential rewards and recognition.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, when the eternal auspicious site was being built at Baohua Valley, Ying He was ordered to supervise construction. He once calmly spoke of Emperor Wen of Han's frugal burial; the emperor praised it, and it was discussed that the old regulations should be reduced somewhat. When the work was completed and Empress Xiaomu was enshrined, he received preferential rewards and recognition.

sentences.zh: 至是地宮浸水，譴責在事諸臣。

translations.literal: At this time the underground palace was inundated, and officials involved were censured.
translations.idiomatic: At this time the underground palace was inundated, and the officials involved were censured.

sentences.zh: 詔以英和始終其事，責尤重，奪職，籍其家。

translations.literal: An edict stated that since Ying He had overseen the matter from beginning to end, his responsibility was especially heavy: his office was stripped and his household was confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated that since Ying He had overseen the matter from beginning to end, his responsibility was especially heavy: his office was stripped and his household was confiscated.

sentences.zh: 逮訊，得開工時見有石母滴水，僅以土攔，議設龍鬚溝出水，英和未允狀，讞擬大辟，會太后為上言不欲以家事誅大臣，乃解發黑龍江充當苦差，子孫並褫職。

translations.literal: Upon arrest and interrogation, it was learned that at the start of construction dripping water was seen from rock strata and only earth was used to block it; a drainage canal was proposed but Ying He did not consent to the report; the sentence proposed execution, but the empress dowager spoke to the emperor, saying she did not wish to execute a great minister over a domestic matter; he was sent under guard to Heilongjiang to serve hard labor, and his descendants' offices were all stripped.
translations.idiomatic: Upon arrest and interrogation, it was learned that at the start of construction dripping water was seen from rock strata and only earth was used to block it; a drainage canal was proposed but Ying He did not consent to the report. The sentence proposed execution, but the empress dowager spoke to the emperor, saying she did not wish to execute a great minister over a domestic matter. He was sent under guard to Heilongjiang to serve hard labor, and his descendants' offices were all stripped.

sentences.zh: 十一年，釋回，复予子孫官。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was released and returned, and his descendants' offices were restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was released and returned, and his descendants' offices were restored.

sentences.zh: 二十年。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year,

sentences.zh: 卒，贈三品卿銜。

translations.literal: He died; he was posthumously granted the rank of third-grade chamberlain.
translations.idiomatic: he died and was posthumously granted the rank of third-grade chamberlain.

sentences.zh: 英和通達政體，遇事有為，而數以罪黜。

translations.literal: Ying He understood the principles of governance, acted resolutely when matters arose, yet was several times dismissed for offenses.
translations.idiomatic: Ying He understood the principles of governance and acted resolutely when matters arose, yet was several times dismissed for offenses.

sentences.zh: 屢掌文衡，愛才好士。

translations.literal: He repeatedly presided over literary examinations and loved talent, honoring scholars.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly presided over literary examinations, loved talent, and honored scholars.

sentences.zh: 自其父及兩子一孫，皆以詞林起家，為​​八旗士族之冠。

translations.literal: From his father through his two sons and one grandson, all rose from the Hanlin Academy—the foremost scholar-official clan among the Eight Banners.
translations.idiomatic: From his father through his two sons and one grandson, all rose from the Hanlin Academy—the foremost scholar-official clan among the Eight Banners.

sentences.zh: 子奎照，嘉慶十九年進士，歷官至禮部尚書、軍機大臣，緣事奪職，復起為左都御史；

translations.literal: His son Kuizhao, a metropolitan graduate in the nineteenth year of Jiaqing, rose through offices to minister of Rites and Grand Councilor; on account of an affair his office was stripped, then he was restored as censor-in-chief on the left;
translations.idiomatic: His son Kuizhao, a metropolitan graduate in the nineteenth year of the Jiaqing reign, rose through offices to minister of Rites and Grand Councilor; on account of an affair his office was stripped, then he was restored as censor-in-chief on the left;

sentences.zh: 奎耀，嘉慶十六年進士，官至通政使，後為南河同知。

translations.literal: Kuiyao, a metropolitan graduate in the sixteenth year of Jiaqing, reached the office of commissioner of the Office of Transmission and later served as subprefect of the Southern Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Kuiyao, a metropolitan graduate in the sixteenth year of the Jiaqing reign, reached the office of commissioner of the Office of Transmission and later served as subprefect of the Southern Rivers.

sentences.zh: 奎照子錫祉，道光十五年進士，歷翰林院侍講學士，後官長蘆鹽運使。

translations.literal: Kuizhao's son Xizhi, a metropolitan graduate in the fifteenth year of Daoguang, served as junior tutor in the Hanlin Academy and later as transport commissioner of Changlu salt.
translations.idiomatic: Kuizhao's son Xizhi, a metropolitan graduate in the fifteenth year of the Daoguang reign, served as junior tutor in the Hanlin Academy and later as transport commissioner of Changlu salt.

sentences.zh: 王鼎，字定九，陝西蒲城人。

translations.literal: Wang Ding, style name Dingjiu, was a native of Pucheng, Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ding, whose style was Dingjiu, was a native of Pucheng in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 少貧，力學，尚氣節。

translations.literal: When young he was poor; he studied diligently and valued integrity.
translations.idiomatic: When young he was poor; he studied diligently and valued integrity.

sentences.zh: 赴禮部試至京，大學士王杰與同族，欲致之，不就。

translations.literal: When he went to the capital for the Ministry of Rites examination, Grand Secretary Wang Jie was of the same clan and wished to bring him under his patronage, but he would not accept.
translations.idiomatic: When he went to the capital for the Ministry of Rites examination, Grand Secretary Wang Jie was of the same clan and wished to bring him under his patronage, but he would not accept.

sentences.zh: 傑曰：「觀子品概，他日名位必繼吾後。」

translations.literal: Jie said: "Judging from your character and bearing, your name and rank in days to come will surely follow after mine."
translations.idiomatic: Jie said: "Judging from your character and bearing, your name and rank in days to come will surely follow after mine."

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，成進士，選庶吉士。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing he passed the metropolitan examination and was selected as a Hanlin bachelor.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Jiaqing reign he passed the metropolitan examination and was selected as a Hanlin bachelor.

sentences.zh: 丁母憂，服除，授編修。

translations.literal: Upon mourning for his mother, when the mourning period ended he was appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: Upon mourning for his mother, when the mourning period ended he was appointed compiler.

sentences.zh: 兩以大考升擢，累遷內閣學士。

translations.literal: Twice through the grand examination he was promoted, and he was successively promoted to grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Twice through the grand examination he was promoted, and he rose in succession to grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十九年，授工部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he was appointed vice minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he was appointed vice minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 仁宗諭曰：「朕向不知汝，亦無人保薦。

translations.literal: The Jiaqing Emperor instructed him: "I had not known you before, nor had anyone recommended you.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiaqing Emperor instructed him: "I had not known you before, nor had anyone recommended you.

sentences.zh: 因閱大考考差文字，知汝學問。

translations.literal: Through reading the examination-assignment essays from the grand examination, I learned your scholarship.
translations.idiomatic: Through reading the examination-assignment essays from the grand examination, I learned your scholarship.

sentences.zh: 屢次召見奏對，知汝品行。

translations.literal: Repeated summonses to audience and replies in memorial showed me your conduct.
translations.idiomatic: Repeated summonses to audience and replies in memorial showed me your conduct.

sentences.zh: 汝是朕特達之知。」

translations.literal: You are one whom I have personally discerned and recognized."
translations.idiomatic: You are one whom I have personally discerned and recognized."

sentences.zh: 調吏部，兼署戶部、刑部。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel and concurrently acted as minister of Revenue and of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel and concurrently acted as minister of Revenue and of Justice.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，兼管順天府尹事，复諭曰：「朕初意授汝督撫，今管順天府尹，猶外任也。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he was additionally placed in charge of the Shuntian governor's affairs; again the emperor instructed him: "My original intention was to appoint you governor-general; now managing the Shuntian governor's affairs is still an external appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he was additionally placed in charge of the Shuntian governor's affairs. Again the emperor instructed him: "My original intention was to appoint you governor-general; now managing the Shuntian governor's affairs is still an external appointment.

sentences.zh: 且留汝在京，以備差往各省查辦事件。」

translations.literal: And I am keeping you in the capital to be ready for commissions to investigate and handle affairs in the various provinces."
translations.idiomatic: And I am keeping you in the capital to be ready for commissions to investigate and handle affairs in the various provinces."

sentences.zh: 自是數奉使出按事鞫獄。

translations.literal: From then on he was repeatedly sent on imperial commission to investigate affairs and try cases.
translations.idiomatic: From then on he was repeatedly sent on imperial commission to investigate affairs and try cases.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，調刑部，又調戶部。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he was transferred to the Ministry of Justice and then again to the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year he was transferred to the Ministry of Justice and then again to the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 道光二年，河南儀工奏銷不實，解巡撫姚祖同任，命鼎偕侍郎玉麟往按，暫署巡撫。

translations.literal: In the second year of Daoguang, when Henan reported irregularities in accounting for ceremonial engineering expenses, the Henan governor Yao Zutong was removed from office; Ding was ordered together with Vice Minister Yulin to investigate and temporarily act as governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Daoguang reign, when Henan reported irregularities in accounting for ceremonial engineering expenses, Henan Governor Yao Zutong was removed from office. Ding was ordered together with Vice Minister Yulin to investigate and temporarily act as governor.

sentences.zh: 疏陳：「儀工用款至辦奏銷，與部例成規不符。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "From the funds used for ceremonial engineering to the completion of the accounting report, the matter does not accord with the standing regulations of the ministry.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "From the funds used for ceremonial engineering to the completion of the accounting report, the matter does not accord with the standing regulations of the ministry.

sentences.zh: 乃以歷辦物料、土方價值，合之豫省成規，互相增減，於稭料、引河等款增銷一百三十萬，夫工、麻斤各款減銷一百三十萬，雖有通融，銀數仍歸實用。

translations.literal: Therefore, taking the prices for materials and earthworks handled over the years and combining them with Henan's standing regulations, they adjusted items back and forth: lines such as straw materials and river-diversion works were increased by 1.3 million in the accounting, while labor, hemp, and other lines were decreased by 1.3 million in the accounting. Although there was flexibility, the silver amounts still corresponded to actual use.
translations.idiomatic: Accordingly, they took the prices for materials and earthworks handled over the years, combined them with Henan's standing regulations, and offset one item against another: straw materials, river-diversion works, and similar lines were increased by 1.3 million in the accounts, while labor, hemp, and other items were reduced by the same amount. Though the figures were adjusted flexibly, the total silver still matched actual expenditure.

sentences.zh: 惟八子錢一款，以銀易錢，多於舊價，每兩提八十文充入經費，而於各員應繳之銀，一併扣算，實違定制。」

translations.literal: Only the item for eight-zi cash—exchanging silver for cash at a rate higher than the old price, extracting eighty cash per tael to cover expenses, and deducting this from the silver each official should pay—truly violated established regulations."
translations.idiomatic: Only the entry for eight-zi cash truly violated established regulations: silver was exchanged for cash at a rate above the old price, eighty cash per tael was taken to cover expenses, and this was deducted from the silver each official was required to remit."

sentences.zh: 疏入，命覈實報銷，而薄譴祖同。

translations.literal: When the memorial arrived, the emperor ordered a verification and settlement of accounts, and meted out mild censure to Zutong.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial arrived, the emperor ordered the accounts verified and settled, and imposed mild censure on Zutong.

sentences.zh: 是年，擢左都御史，父憂歸。

translations.literal: That year he was promoted to left censor-in-chief, then returned home upon his father's death.
translations.idiomatic: That year he was promoted to left censor-in-chief, then returned home to mourn his father's death.

sentences.zh: 五年，服闋，以一品銜署戶部侍郎，授軍機大臣。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, when his mourning period ended, he was appointed acting vice minister of Revenue with first-rank designation and made a Grand Council member.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, when his mourning period ended, he was appointed acting vice minister of Revenue with first-rank designation and was made a Grand Council member.

sentences.zh: 浙江德清徐倪氏因奸謀斃徐蔡氏獄三年不決，按察使王維詢因自盡，巡撫程含章與按察使祁鞫之，甫得情而犯婦在監自縊。

translations.literal: In Deqing, Zhejiang, a case in which a woman of the Xu and Ni families had plotted through an affair to kill Lady Xu of the Cai clan had gone unresolved in court for three years. Provincial surveillance commissioner Wang Weixun committed suicide over it. Governor Cheng Hanzhao and surveillance commissioner Qi tried the case; just as the facts were established, the female defendant hanged herself in prison.
translations.idiomatic: In Deqing, Zhejiang, a case in which a woman of the Xu and Ni families had plotted through an adulterous affair to kill Lady Xu of the Cai clan had remained unresolved in court for three years. Provincial surveillance commissioner Wang Weixun committed suicide over the affair. Governor Cheng Hanzhao and surveillance commissioner Qi tried the case, but just as the facts were established, the female defendant hanged herself in prison.

sentences.zh: 宣宗特命鼎典鄉試，就治其獄，廉得徐故富家，以獄破其產，官吏多受賕，勾結朦庇，致獄情譸幻。

translations.literal: The Daoguang Emperor specially ordered Ding to preside over the provincial examination and, while there, take charge of the case. Investigation revealed that the Xu family had once been wealthy; officials had used the case to ruin their estate, many had taken bribes, and collusion and concealment had made the case muddled and fantastical.
